title: AI-Enabled Pathology Model for Precision Diagnosis and Treatment
summary: Huawei reports that RuiPath reduced pathology-review time at Ruijin Hospital, including initial review from 20–40 to 10–15 minutes per patient.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The RuiPath pathology pilot covers 11 subspecialties at Ruijin Hospital. Huawei reports shorter review and report-preparation workflows, including initial review of 10–15 minutes rather than 20–40 minutes. The source also claims model-accuracy and data-engineering benefits. Some percentage and timing statements differ, and no patient-specific treatment improvement is reported.
purpose: Assist pathology analysis and reduce report-preparation work.

ratings.reason: In the Ruijin pilot, initial review reportedly fell from 20–40 to 10–15 minutes per patient.
No patient-specific diagnosis, treatment change, or recovery is reported.
Improved global public health is aspirational.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 14: AI-Enabled Pathology Model for Precision Diagnosis and Treatment

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: RuiPath shortens pathology review at Ruijin Hospital
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
